LibRaw 0.22.1 source availability
=================================

FilmLab elects CDDL-1.0 for its distribution of unmodified LibRaw 0.22.1.
The covered source is available from:

https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw/releases/tag/0.22.1
https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw/archive/refs/tags/0.22.1.tar.gz

The archive expected by the pinned vcpkg port has SHA-512:

123050ea30366ada37b40e0aee84453f71f10a5e5e39261a1d16b96dc395f85a9ecdfd043d51b4c347a67546affdfa7ca84c10fa84d73b9b4070c074f1d301e8

FilmLab's reproducible build recipe is native/raw-worker/vcpkg.json at vcpkg
baseline cd61e1e26a038e82d6550a3ebbe0fbbfe7da78e3 together with
native/raw-worker/CMakeLists.txt. The vcpkg port copies the build system from
LibRaw-cmake commit eb98e4325aef2ce85d2eb031c2ff18640ca616d3. FilmLab does
not carry or apply a LibRaw source patch.

To reconstruct the library and RAW worker, check out the FilmLab source at the
release tag, install the manifest with the documented static triplet, and run
the CMake commands in native/raw-worker/README.md. The FilmLab repository URL
is https://github.com/LichengWang04/FlimLab . If access to that repository is
restricted, request the corresponding build recipe from the distributor who
provided the binary.

This source notice remains valid for FilmLab releases that identify LibRaw
0.22.1 and the baseline above. A later decoder version must ship a replacement
notice and updated source hash.
